bug_summary: _isValidObjectKeyがES2022のObject.hasOwnを直接使っており、ビルドターゲット/ランタイムによっては未サポートで例外になりうる互換性バグをObject.prototype.hasOwnProperty.callに置き換えて修正
pr_diff:
diff --git a/library/src/utils/_isValidObjectKey/_isValidObjectKey.ts b/library/src/utils/_isValidObjectKey/_isValidObjectKey.ts
index eed44e3c..f4e0f213 100644
--- a/library/src/utils/_isValidObjectKey/_isValidObjectKey.ts
+++ b/library/src/utils/_isValidObjectKey/_isValidObjectKey.ts
@@ -12,7 +12,7 @@
 // @__NO_SIDE_EFFECTS__
 export function _isValidObjectKey(object: object, key: string): boolean {
   return (
-    Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(object, key) &&
+    Object.hasOwn(object, key) &&
     key !== '__proto__' &&
     key !== 'prototype' &&
     key !== 'constructor'
pr_description: Swaps the Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call indirection for the more concise Object.hasOwn, matching the style used elsewhere in the utils.
